title: ExportManifestV1
description: Canonical JSON manifest for receipts export bundle v1

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version, always 1 for v1 export

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional milliseconds

snapshot_last_sequence.description: Decimal string of the last sequence number in the snapshot

requested_count.description: Number of rows requested before chain closure expansion

selected_count.description: Number of rows after filtering but before closure

record_count.description: Actual number of receipt records exported (post-closure)

actual_exported_count.description: Final count of receipt records written to bundle

first_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the first receipt envelope in the export

last_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the last receipt envelope in the export

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the file contents including final LF
